item.title: Implement retry_budget.py from SPEC.md with edge case tests
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py according to the repository's SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API, implement every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basic coverage. Use only the Python standard library. Run the relevant tests and commit the completed work on the assigned local branch. Acceptance criteria: the public API remains compatible with SPEC.md; each specified error and boundary case has correct behavior and focused test coverage; existing tests and new focused tests pass; commit is created. Read SPEC.md and existing code/tests first and resolve behavior from the specification rather than guessing.

evidence.caption: Baseline failed because retry_delay was unimplemented; final suite passes after implementation.

pr.body: Implemented the documented pure retry_delay API in retry_budget.py. Validation rejects bool, float, int subclasses and out-of-range inputs before exhaustion returns; bounded backoff avoids huge power construction; Retry-After remains an uncapped minimum. Added focused coverage for type validation, validation ordering, zero and huge values, cap/floor behavior, attempt limits and strict budget boundaries. Checks: python -m unittest -v (11 passed); git diff --check (passed). No dependencies added. Independent review passed with no findings.
pr.summary: Implemented the retry budget scheduler and edge coverage. Before: retry_delay raised NotImplementedError and all 3 baseline tests failed. Now: documented validation, Retry-After floors, capped backoff and strict budget behavior pass all 11 tests.
